name: Late arrival
first_message: Hi — my train is delayed and I won't get in until about 1am. Is that a problem for my booking tonight?

name: Breakfast and parking
first_message: Morning! Two questions — what time does breakfast finish on a Saturday, and can I reserve a parking space in advance?

name: Travelling with a dog
first_message: We're bringing our labrador next weekend. Which rooms can we book and is there a charge?

name: Wants a refund
first_message: I need to cancel tomorrow's booking and get my money back. It was a saver rate. Can you refund me now?

name: Accessibility check
first_message: My father uses a wheelchair. Can he get to the restaurant and the rooftop bar without stairs?
